announcement.title: Session handoffs and clearer device approvals
announcement.description: Managed conversation capture now preserves links when authorized local sessions share context, where enabled by your workspace. Halofy Connect shows which account is approving a device, lets you switch accounts without losing the device code, and helps distinguish devices with the same name. This release also includes setup-sharing status and recovery controls, and retains the selected-provider budget fix from the previous update.
